description: This Java class 'ModuleFilterDefinition' encapsulates the configuration details of a web filter within an OpenMRS module, including filter name, class, and initialization parameters. It provides methods to parse XML configuration and retrieve filter definitions for a module.

classes.name: ModuleFilterDefinition
classes.description: A class that holds the configuration details for a module's web filter, including its name, class, and init parameters.

methods.name: retrieveFilterDefinitions
methods.description: Static method that parses a module's XML configuration to retrieve a list of filter definitions.

methods.name: addInitParameter
methods.description: Adds an initialization parameter to the filter configuration.
